notes.title: 👑 Once Upon a Kingdom — Demo is Now LIVE on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]The gates of the kingdom are open! 🏰✨[/h3]  

[h3]The [b]Once Upon a Kingdom[/b] demo has officially arrived on Steam[/h3]  

[p]In this demo, you’ll step into the role of a ruler building and guiding your very own kingdom. Manage your lands, care for your people, and make choices that will echo through your realm’s history. Whether you’re expanding your borders, forging alliances, or defending against threats, every decision shapes your kingdom’s destiny.[/p]  

[p]This is just the beginning of your story, and we’d love for you to be part of its creation. Your feedback will help us refine the experience and make the full game even more magical.[/p]  

[p]🎮 [b]Play the Demo Now[/b][/p]  

[p]Take your place on the throne, ruler… your kingdom awaits. 👑⚔️[/p]  

[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316970/Once_Upon_A_Kingdom/"][/dynamiclink][/p]  

[p]Follow us on Instagram and join our Discord tavern for cozy chaos and sneak peeks. See you in the Kingdom! 🏰💛[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Once Upon A Kingdom & meet our publisher
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303111/f13a573d199a6805bb5e0401b1e6be3a392b6fdb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2]🎉 Hello future rulers of the realm![/h2][p]We’ve been keeping this magical secret for a while, and now it’s finally time to share it with you! [b]Once Upon A Kingdom[/b] is coming! ✨
Imagine building your dream kingdom, guiding quirky villagers, and making big (and sometimes silly) royal decisions. Yup, it’s charming, cozy, and full of fairytale chaos. Just the way we like it.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]👑 Big News![/h2][p]We’re super excited to announce that we’ve officially teamed up with [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio?snr=1_2108_9__2107"]indie.io[/url] as our publisher! 🎊
These awesome folks are helping us bring the kingdom to more players around the world. With their support (and their marketing wizardry 🪄), we can focus on making the game extra magical, while they help us behind the scenes.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]💌 Wishlist It Now![/h2][p]Add [b]Once Upon A Kingdom[/b] to your Steam Wishlist so you don’t miss out on updates, demos, or royal secrets.
Your throne awaits... soon-ish. 👀👑[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3316970/"][/dynamiclink]
